title: CRM Dashboard
summary: CRM dashboard with top row containing four stat cards (ratings, sessions, customers with illustrations, transactions with stat pills), followed by a total sales line chart and revenue report bar chart with donut overlay for sales overview. Middle section has an activity timeline with colored dots and descriptions, weekly sales bar chart with avatar breakdown, and two small stat cards. Bottom section features an upgrade-your-plan marketing card with pricing tiers and a meeting schedule card listing upcoming calendar events with times and attendees.

layout.columns: 12-column grid: top row 4 equal stat cards (~3 cols each), second row split between total-sales (4 cols), revenue-report (4 cols), sales-overview donut (4 cols), third row timeline (4 cols), weekly-sales (4 cols), two stacked stat cards (4 cols), bottom row upgrade-plan (4 cols) and meeting-schedule (8 cols)
